title: Enhancing simulations of disordered protein ensembles with chemical shift restraints in coarse-grained models.
authors: Cullen, Mina; Biancaniello, Carmen; Taskova, Katerina; Miletic, Vedran; De Simone, Alfonso; Mercadante, Davide
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文通过人工神经网络从Cα坐标预测化学位移，为粗粒度模型引入化学位移约束，增强对无序蛋白构象 ensembles 中瞬时二级结构的采样，属于蛋白质构象采样与结构计算建模的方法创新。
abstract: With more than one third of the human proteome being structurally disordered, intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are key contributors to complex cellular functions, despite their highly dynamic conformational ensembles remaining elusive to conventional techniques in structural biology. Coarse-grained (CG) simulation methods thus serve as a gold standard to refine IDP ensembles. These methods, when relying on elastic network models or rigid body to sample secondary structure, are however inherently limited in their capability to model and sample transient secondary structure at a residue-level resolution as informed by experimental data. This fundamental limitation persists despite experimental evidence suggesting that transient structural propensities are a fundamental hallmark of IDP function. Through an artificial neural network capable of predicting backbone chemical shifts from C(alpha)-only protein conformations, we present a generalized framework which does not rely on dihedral parameterization to equip one bead-per-aminoacid CG force fields with the ability to sample functional elements of secondary structure. When applied on a large set of IDPs in isolation or condensates, our approach correctly recapitulates both local and global arrangements, yielding experimentally informed ensembles that can inform structure-mediated function and resolve force field limitations. This can yield a fruitful exploration of ensemble-to-function relationships in IDPs, allowing to explore phenomena such as secondary structure propensity and nucleation in condensates, conformationally selected binding motifs across disordered ensembles or conformational preferences of sequence-specific short-linear motifs.
abstract_zh: 由于人类蛋白质组中超过三分之一的结构呈无序状态， intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 是复杂细胞功能的关键贡献者，尽管其高度动态的构象集合对传统结构生物学技术而言仍难以捉摸。因此，粗粒化 (coarse-grained, CG) 模拟方法成为优化IDP集合的金标准。然而，这些方法在依赖弹性网络模型或刚体来采样二级结构时，其建模和采样残基级分辨率下瞬时二级结构的能力固有受限，而这种分辨率正是实验数据所提供的信息。尽管实验证据表明瞬时结构倾向性是IDP功能的基本标志，这一根本性限制依然存在。通过一种能够从仅含C(alpha)的蛋白质构象预测骨架化学位移的人工神经网络，我们提出了一种通用框架，该框架不依赖二面角参数化，使每个氨基酸一个珠子的CG力场具备采样二级结构功能元件的能力。当应用于大量孤立或凝聚体中的IDPs时，我们的方法正确重现了局部和全局排列，生成了实验信息化的集合，这些集合可揭示结构介导的功能并解决力场局限性。这能促进对IDPs中集合-功能关系的富有成效的探索，允许研究诸如凝聚体中的二级结构倾向性和成核现象、跨无序集合的构象选择结合基序，或序列特异性短线性基序的构象偏好等现象。
